programs.title: Wild Prague
programs.desc: Prague is one of the greatest tourist attractions the world has to offer. Whether it be the medieval atmosphere, or the Kafkaesque spirit, millions of people are drawn to it. But the Mother of all Cities also has a particular hidden aspect – hundreds of rare species you’d hardly expect to see here live within sight of the Old Town Square’s Astronomical Clock and Charles Bridge.
